dataset: Agent Forge Lab v1 — entirely synthetic IT operations research

documents.title: Login investigation for staging server
documents.text: On 2026-10-20, the staging server recorded five failed login attempts from 192.0.2.44. The identity team reviewed the source against the test-device inventory. No unauthorized account change was observed. The case remained open for analyst review.

documents.title: Approved maintenance and authentication activity
documents.text: Maintenance change CHG-SYN-202 was approved for the synthetic test host on 2026-10-21 between 19:00 and 21:00 local time. The recorded successful administrator login occurred during that maintenance window. The service owner confirmed that this login was planned. Approval was checked against the synthetic change register.

documents.title: Unresolved privileged access review
documents.text: The test directory showed a successful privileged role change without a linked ticket. Analysts requested supporting approval evidence from the account owner. The role change was marked pending verification; the available records did not establish malicious intent.

documents.title: False positive review process
documents.text: A false positive is a detection that does not represent the action the rule intends to flag under the review policy. Analysts compare timestamps, account activity, authorized changes, and supporting device records before closing a case. Suppression policy changes require a separately reviewed exception.

documents.title: Threat hunting playbook note
documents.text: Identity investigations should preserve original event identifiers and use read-only queries first. Investigators should separate observed facts from hypotheses. Remediation requests require approval from a designated human reviewer.
